claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. At actual N>=2 set n=N, L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)), U=ceil(L^(3/4)), E=5*U*ceil(sqrt B), Kmin=2^ceil(E/2), k=Kmin^2, t=2^ceil(2*ceil(L^(1/4))*ceil(sqrt B)/19), q=ceil(sqrt L), Pmax=2^U. Use the supplied seed-aware SU-style linear strong extractor, affine block-source reduction and challenge-response tree on exact intervals[floor(i*N/t^j),floor((i+1)*N/t^j)). The full response seed is numerically required to be at most(37/10)*ceil(log2 N), proved eventually using the supplied relative prime-interval theorem. All field/Singer-cycle constructions, integer guards and total fallback0 are explicit. Every input bit is charged, without outer padding, ignored target bits, advice, program prefix or field input.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this ONE fixed total uniform P language, hence NP with empty witnesses, there exists N0 such that for EVERY integer N>=N0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8*2^(2ceil(5*ceil((ceil(log2 N))^(3/4))*ceil(sqrt(ceil(log2(ceil(log2 N)+1))))/2))+4. The loss is2^((5+o(1))*(log2 N)^(3/4)*sqrt(log2(log2 N)))=N^o(1). For this SAME fixed family, for EVERY fixed real epsilon>0 there exists N_epsilon such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^epsilon for EVERY integer N>=N_epsilon. Thus liminf over ALL integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. Complete supplied proofs establish the deterministic fields, Singer-cycle construction, seed-aware linear strong extractor with logarithmic seed at subpolynomial entropy, small-error transfer extractor, cubic extractor, affine row/block-source extraction, recursive tree dispersion and unrestricted full-B2 transfer at actual length. No explicit threshold, practical asymptotically large evaluator time, literature record, prior verdict or external retrieval premise is claimed.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
